title: Slices of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity a.e. (Simon 4.1–4.5)
statement: For all P, m, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ and M_W(∂T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U and every f : ℝ^P → ℝ which is L-Lipschitz on U: if T is integer multiplicity, then for L¹-almost every t ∈ ℝ every S ∈ D_m(U) with IsSlice T f t S is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W < ∞ ∧ T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn U m, IsSlice T f t S → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
